svg.title: Bluetooth: pair first, then connect
svg.desc: Pair the phone in Windows Bluetooth settings first. No sender APK needed.

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
g.text: Pair the phone in Windows Bluetooth settings first. No sender APK needed.
Select the phone and PC output in Settings.
Select the PC as its Bluetooth output.
